pipeline.modality: T-cell activator immunotherapy (cationic lipid R-DOTAP + HPV-16 E6/E7 peptides)
pipeline.target: HPV-16 E6/E7 (induces HPV16-specific CD8+ T-cell response)

indications.indication: HPV16-positive recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC), first line
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized study of PDS0101 + pembrolizumab vs pembrolizumab monotherapy in HPV16+ R/M HNSCC first-line. Primary endpoint OS; Type C meeting requested Oct 2025 to discuss adding PFS as interim primary endpoint.
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (started 2025-05-30; primary completion target 2029-02)
key_milestones: Type C meeting with FDA requested Oct 2025 for proposed PFS interim endpoint amendment
VERSATILE-002 Phase 2 final OS topline data Aug 2025; low-CPS subgroup data Sep 2025

indications.indication: Locally advanced cervical cancer (Stage IB3-IVA), with chemoradiation
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 trial of PDS0101 in combination with chemoradiation for stage IB3-IVA cervical cancer; investigator-sponsored at MD Anderson Cancer Center.
indications.lead_sponsor: M.D. Anderson Cancer Center (PDS0101 is PDS Biotech's asset)
key_milestones: Updated Phase 2 data presented at ASTRO 2024

pipeline.modality: Antibody-drug conjugate / fusion (IL-12 fused to NHS76 antibody targeting necrotic tumor regions)
pipeline.target: DNA/histone necrotic core (NHS76); delivers IL-12 to tumor microenvironment
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from Merck KGaA / co-developed via NCI CRADAs

indications.trial_name: Combination immunotherapy for advanced HPV-associated cancers
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 of PDS01ADC + bintrafusp alfa +/- additional immunotherapy in HPV-associated malignancies.
indications.lead_sponsor: National Cancer Institute (NCI) — CRADA partner; PDS01ADC is PDS Biotech's asset

indications.indication: Metastatic colorectal cancer (with HAIP and systemic therapy)
indications.trial_name: PDS01ADC + Hepatic Artery Infusion Pump combination
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 of PDS01ADC plus hepatic artery infusion pump (HAIP) and systemic therapy in metastatic CRC.
indications.trial_status: Recruiting; colorectal cohort met pre-defined criteria for stage 2 expansion (announced Jul 2025).

indications.indication: Recurrent prostate cancer (PET+, without testosterone suppression)
indications.trial_name: Enzalutamide + PDS01ADC in PET-positive recurrent prostate cancer
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 of enzalutamide combined with PDS01ADC in PET-positive recurrent prostate cancer without testosterone suppression.

indications.indication: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (with docetaxel + abiraterone)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 of PDS01ADC with docetaxel and abiraterone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

indications.trial_name: PDS01ADC monotherapy and with M7824 in advanced Kaposi sarcoma
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 of PDS01ADC alone and in combination with bintrafusp alfa (M7824) in advanced Kaposi sarcoma.
